items.title: Micron, Accenture, Google, IBM, Fair Isaac, Synopsys, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks fell Thursday as bond yields continued to rise after notching their largest quarterly gain since 1994.  Micron dropped 1.9% after the company posted a stellar fiscal fourth-quarter earnings report.

items.title: 3 Reasons Investors Love Fair Isaac Corporation (FICO)
items.summary: What a brutal six months it’s been for Fair Isaac Corporation. The stock has dropped 44.3% and now trades at a new 52-week low of $591.41, rattling many shareholders. This was partly due to its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.

items.title: Bank of America Cut Its Fair Isaac Price Target in Half and the Stock Still Fell Below It
items.summary: Bank of America slashed its Fair Isaac price target by half, yet the stock kept falling right through it. What regulators just changed about mortgage credit scoring may have permanently altered the case for owning FICO.

items.title: Why Fair Isaac Stock Is Surging After Its Worst Quarter on Record
items.summary: Fair Isaac  investors would be forgiven if they felt like they had whiplash.  Fresh off the stock’s worst quarterly performance on record, shares surged 9.5% to $648.12 on Thursday.  The only question for investors to ask is if shares of  Fair Isaac  maker of the FICO score, have finally bottomed after falling more than 48% in September.

items.title: How Big Could Fair Isaac Stock's Next Fall Be?
items.summary: Fair Isaac (FICO) stock fell 27% in the past month with no company news to explain it. Equifax and TransUnion fell more than 20% too. If you hold the shares, you may wonder what a full market shock would do to them. Fair Isaac's record in past shocks can size the next fall, but only if the company that fell then is yours. So is today's Fair Isaac the same company that fell in past shocks.

items.title: Moderna and Fair Isaac: The Best and Worst S&P 500 Stocks for the Third Quarter
items.summary: Moderna stock has rallied since the company unveiled clinical updates to its cancer vaccine in collaboration with Merck in late August.

items.title: Is Fair Isaac Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
items.summary: Fair Isaac (FICO), the maker of the FICO Score, beats Equifax, TransUnion and three other peers on revenue growth and operating margin. Yet its stock lost 59.3% over the past twelve months, the worst return in the group. So after that fall, is Fair Isaac stock worth more than its competitors.
